The Linux4.BE Bootloader

The bootloader used in this project is a modified version of CyaCE. You can download it here, or alternatively use the sources from CVS.
If you place a file named AutoRun.exe in a directory named \Storage Card\CE\R4100 (on a compact flash card), the AutoRun.exe file will run whenever you insert the flash card. So if you want the bootloader to start automatically after inserting the CF card, rename the bootloader to AutoRun.exe and put it in the above location together with the kernel images and config file.
